purpose: Reconcile the supplied receiving-history evidence package, preserve distinct records, and update the evidence request queue only when a source contains the requested transaction-level evidence.
methods: Computed SHA-256 and byte size for every supplied file.
Compared every PDF hash against every existing evidence catalog before adding a record.
Opened every supplied PDF and verified its page count; the distinct FY2017 report was text-searched and its first page plus the cited leachate-revenue page were visually inspected.
Imported both CSV files as structured workbooks and verified their row and column counts.
Compared the recovered evidence descriptions and limitations against each independently closable receiving-history requirement.

addedRecords.finding: The report states that FY2017 revenue for treating Wexford County Landfill leachate exceeded budget by $307,683. It is aggregate audited context, not transaction-level evidence.
Evidence intake manifest identifying what each supplied source establishes and its limitations.
Recovery inventory defining the seven receiving-history record series that remain outstanding.

queueResolution.reason: The supplied package establishes the receiving relationship, aggregate volume and revenue context, and cessation context, but none of the files contains per-load tickets, receiving-log rows, delivery-linked invoices or receipts, signed agreement amendments, or the dated final delivery entry.
queueResolution.trackingRecordPolicy: An evidence manifest or not-yet-recovered inventory cannot satisfy a requirement merely because it names the missing record.
